def requireValue(String name, String value) {
    value = value?.trim()
    if (!value) error("${name} must be configured in Jenkins.")
    value
}

def isCommitSha(String value) { value ==~ /[0-9a-fA-F]{40}/ }

def shortRef(String ref) { isCommitSha(ref) ? ref.take(7) : ref }

def validateBranchName(String name, String value) {
    if (!(value ==~ /[A-Za-z0-9][A-Za-z0-9._\/-]*/)
        || value.contains('..') || value.contains('//') || value.endsWith('/')
        || value.endsWith('.') || value.endsWith('.lock')) {
        error("${name} must be a safe branch name or full 40-character commit SHA, got '${value}'.")
    }
    value
}

def validateRef(String name, String value) {
    value = requireValue(name, value)
    isCommitSha(value) ? value.toLowerCase() : validateBranchName(name, value)
}

def checkoutRef(String ref, String localRef) {
    def refspec = isCommitSha(ref) ? "+${ref}:refs/remotes/origin/${localRef}" : "+refs/heads/${ref}:refs/remotes/origin/${localRef}"
    checkout([$class: 'GitSCM', branches: [[name: "refs/remotes/origin/${localRef}"]],
        doGenerateSubmoduleConfigurations: false,
        extensions: [[$class: 'CleanBeforeCheckout'], [$class: 'CloneOption', depth: 1, honorRefspec: true, noTags: true, shallow: true]],
        userRemoteConfigs: [[refspec: refspec, url: 'https://github.com/gkeyllorg/gkeyll.git']]])
}

def checkoutPullRequest(String number) {
    checkout([$class: 'GitSCM', branches: [[name: 'refs/remotes/origin/candidate']],
        doGenerateSubmoduleConfigurations: false,
        extensions: [[$class: 'CleanBeforeCheckout'], [$class: 'CloneOption', depth: 1, honorRefspec: true, noTags: true, shallow: true]],
        userRemoteConfigs: [[refspec: "+refs/pull/${number}/head:refs/remotes/origin/candidate", url: 'https://github.com/gkeyllorg/gkeyll.git']]])
}

def pullRequestBase(String statusCredentialsId, String number) {
    def base = ''
    withCredentials([usernamePassword(credentialsId: statusCredentialsId, usernameVariable: 'GITHUB_USERNAME', passwordVariable: 'GITHUB_TOKEN')]) {
        base = sh(returnStdout: true, script: """#!/bin/bash
            set -euo pipefail
            curl --fail --silent --show-error --header 'Accept: application/vnd.github+json' --header \"Authorization: Bearer \$GITHUB_TOKEN\" https://api.github.com/repos/gkeyllorg/gkeyll/pulls/${number} | python3 -c 'import json,sys; print(json.load(sys.stdin)["base"]["ref"])'
        """).trim()
    }
    validateBranchName('GitHub PR base branch', base)
}

def publishStatus(String statusCredentialsId, String context, String commit, String state, String description) {
    if (state == 'pending' && params.CI_QUEUE_ID?.trim()) {
        description = "Gkeyll CI running: starting (Jenkins queue #${params.CI_QUEUE_ID})."
    }
    withCredentials([usernamePassword(credentialsId: statusCredentialsId, usernameVariable: 'GITHUB_USERNAME', passwordVariable: 'GITHUB_TOKEN')]) {
        withEnv(["CI_STATUS_CONTEXT=${context}", "CI_STATUS_COMMIT=${commit}", "CI_STATUS_STATE=${state}", "CI_STATUS_DESCRIPTION=${description.take(140)}"]) {
            sh '''#!/bin/bash
                set -euo pipefail
                payload="$(python3 -c 'import json,os; print(json.dumps({"state":os.environ["CI_STATUS_STATE"],"context":os.environ["CI_STATUS_CONTEXT"],"description":os.environ["CI_STATUS_DESCRIPTION"]}))')"
                curl --fail --silent --show-error --request POST --header 'Accept: application/vnd.github+json' --header "Authorization: Bearer $GITHUB_TOKEN" --header 'Content-Type: application/json' --data "$payload" "https://api.github.com/repos/gkeyllorg/gkeyll/statuses/$CI_STATUS_COMMIT"
            '''
        }
    }
}

def timeCommand(String metricFile, String command) {
    // Keep the command's output in a log next to its metric file. On failure,
    // extract the error lines into ci-failure-detail.txt (workspace root) so
    // the GitHub report shows the actual compiler or test error.
    def logFile = metricFile.replaceFirst(/-seconds\.txt$/, '') + '.log'
    def detailFile = metricFile.replaceFirst(/[^\/]*$/, '') + 'ci-failure-detail.txt'
    def logName = logFile.replaceFirst(/^\.\.\//, '')
    sh """#!/bin/bash
        set -euo pipefail
        started=\$(date +%s)
        if ! ( ${command} ) 2>&1 | tee '${logFile}'; then
            {
                echo "Command: ${command}"
                echo "Full log: ${logName} (archived with the build)"
                echo '--- error lines ---'
                grep -nE 'error:|undefined reference|FAIL |^make.*Error [0-9]+' '${logFile}' | head -n 40 || true
                echo '--- last 40 lines ---'
                tail -n 40 '${logFile}'
            } > '${detailFile}'
            exit 1
        fi
        elapsed=\$(( \$(date +%s) - started ))
        printf '%s\\n' "\$elapsed" > '${metricFile}'
        echo "${metricFile}: \$elapsed seconds"
    """
}

// Capture stdout and stderr without losing the command's exit status. Never
// use this for credential-bearing commands. Logs live outside the baseline tree.
def loggedSh(String label, String script) {
    def quoted = "'" + script.replace("'", "'\"'\"'") + "'"
    withEnv(["CI_COMMAND_LOG=${env.WORKSPACE}/ci-command-logs/${label}.log"]) {
        sh """#!/bin/bash
            set -uo pipefail
            mkdir -p "\$WORKSPACE/ci-command-logs"
            bash ${script.startsWith('#!/bin/bash -l') ? '-l' : ''} -e -o pipefail -c ${quoted} 2>&1 | tee "\$CI_COMMAND_LOG"
            result=\$?
            printf '%s\\n' "\$result" > "\$CI_COMMAND_LOG.exit"
            exit "\$result"
        """
    }
}

def trustedReportScript() {
    // The report tool must come from reviewed code, never from the candidate
    // checkout, because 'publish' runs with the GitHub token bound.
    def trustedDir = env.TRUSTED_CI_DIR?.trim()
    if (trustedDir) {
        sh "cp '${trustedDir}/ci/jenkins/github_report.py' _trusted_github_report.py"
    } else {
        // GKEYLL_CI_TRUSTED_REF exists so a reviewed CI branch can be staged
        // before merge; production controllers leave it unset (main).
        def ref = validateRef('GKEYLL_CI_TRUSTED_REF', env.GKEYLL_CI_TRUSTED_REF?.trim() ?: 'main')
        withEnv(["CI_TRUSTED_REPORT_REF=${ref}"]) {
            sh '''#!/bin/bash
                set -euo pipefail
                mkdir -p .ci-report-source
                git -C .ci-report-source init --quiet
                git -C .ci-report-source fetch --quiet --depth 1 https://github.com/gkeyllorg/gkeyll.git "$CI_TRUSTED_REPORT_REF"
                git -C .ci-report-source show FETCH_HEAD:ci/jenkins/github_report.py > _trusted_github_report.py
            '''
        }
    }
    return '_trusted_github_report.py'
}

def publishReport(String statusCredentialsId, String context, String platform, String commit, String state, String candidatePr, String candidateRef) {
    def script = trustedReportScript()
    withEnv(["CI_REPORT_CONTEXT=${context}", "CI_REPORT_PLATFORM=${platform}", "CI_REPORT_RESULT=${state}",
             "CI_REPORT_PR=${candidatePr ?: ''}", "CI_REPORT_COMMIT=${commit}", "CI_REPORT_REF=${candidateRef ?: ''}"]) {
        sh "python3 ${script} build --platform \"\$CI_REPORT_PLATFORM\" --context \"\$CI_REPORT_CONTEXT\" --result \"\$CI_REPORT_RESULT\" --pr \"\$CI_REPORT_PR\" --output ci-report.md"
        withCredentials([usernamePassword(credentialsId: statusCredentialsId, usernameVariable: 'GITHUB_USERNAME', passwordVariable: 'GITHUB_TOKEN')]) {
            retry(3) {
                sh "python3 ${script} publish --report ci-report.md --commit \"\$CI_REPORT_COMMIT\" --context \"\$CI_REPORT_CONTEXT\" --pr \"\$CI_REPORT_PR\" --ref \"\$CI_REPORT_REF\""
            }
        }
    }
    // One line naming the failing layer/tests, for the GitHub status description.
    return fileExists('ci-status-description.txt') ? readFile('ci-status-description.txt').trim() : ''
}

def buildTree(String label, String prefix, String mkdeps, String configure, String jobs) {
    def metricDirectory = label == 'baseline' ? '../' : ''
    def mpiHome = env.PERSONAL_MPI_HOME?.trim() ?: "${prefix}/openmpi"
    withEnv(["PREFIX=${prefix}", "MPI_HOME=${mpiHome}"]) {
        loggedSh("${label}-setup", """#!/bin/bash
            set -euo pipefail
            ./machines/${mkdeps}
            ./machines/${configure}
        """)
        timeCommand("${metricDirectory}${label}-unit-build-seconds.txt", "make -j${jobs} unit")
        timeCommand("${metricDirectory}${label}-unit-test-seconds.txt", "GKYL_UNIT_RESULTS='${env.WORKSPACE}/${label}-unit-results.txt' make unit-run")
        timeCommand("${metricDirectory}${label}-regression-build-seconds.txt", "make -j${jobs} regression")
        timeCommand("${metricDirectory}${label}-install-seconds.txt", "make -j${jobs} install")
    }
}

def createBaseline(String baseline, String mkdeps, String configure, String jobs, String regressionJobs) {
    dir('_baseline') {
        deleteDir()
        checkoutRef(baseline, 'baseline')
        sh 'git rev-parse HEAD | tee ../ci-baseline-commit.txt'
        buildTree('baseline', "${env.WORKSPACE}/_baseline/gkylsoft", mkdeps, configure, jobs)
        loggedSh("baseline-regression-configure", "\"${env.WORKSPACE}/_baseline/gkylsoft/gkeyll/bin/gkeyll\" runregression configure --source-dir \"${env.WORKSPACE}/_baseline\" --prefix \"${env.WORKSPACE}/_baseline/gkylsoft\"")
        timeCommand('../baseline-c-compile-seconds.txt', "\"${env.WORKSPACE}/_baseline/gkylsoft/gkeyll/bin/gkeyll\" runregression run --c-only compile --jobs ${jobs}")
        timeCommand('../baseline-c-regression-create-seconds.txt', "\"${env.WORKSPACE}/_baseline/gkylsoft/gkeyll/bin/gkeyll\" runregression run --c-only --execute-only create --timeout 900 --jobs ${regressionJobs}")
    }
}

def runCandidateRegressions(String jobs, String regressionJobs) {
    def gkeyll = "${env.WORKSPACE}/gkylsoft/gkeyll/bin/gkeyll"
    def results = "${env.WORKSPACE}/gkylsoft/gkeyll-results"
    def baseline = "${env.WORKSPACE}/_baseline/gkylsoft/gkeyll-results"
    loggedSh("candidate-regression-configure", "\"${gkeyll}\" runregression configure --source-dir \"${env.WORKSPACE}\" --prefix \"${env.WORKSPACE}/gkylsoft\"")
    timeCommand('candidate-c-compile-seconds.txt', "\"${gkeyll}\" runregression run --c-only compile --jobs ${jobs}")
    loggedSh("candidate-regression-check", """set -euo pipefail
        for layer in moments vlasov gyrokinetic pkpm; do
            if [ -d \"${baseline}/\$layer/creg-accepted\" ]; then
                rm -rf \"${results}/\$layer/creg-accepted\"
                mv \"${baseline}/\$layer/creg-accepted\" \"${results}/\$layer/creg-accepted\"
            fi
        done
        started=\$(date +%s)
        \"${gkeyll}\" runregression run --c-only --execute-only check --timeout 900 --jobs ${regressionJobs}
        elapsed=\$(( \$(date +%s) - started ))
        printf '%s\\n' "\$elapsed" > candidate-c-regression-check-seconds.txt
        echo "Candidate C-regression check runtime: \$elapsed seconds"
        \"${gkeyll}\" ci/jenkins/check_regression_results.lua \"${results}\" ci/jenkins/expected_regression_diffs.txt ci-regression-summary.txt
    """)
}

def runParallelRegressions(String mpiExec) {
    def mpiHome = env.PERSONAL_MPI_HOME?.trim()
    mpiExec = mpiExec ?: (mpiHome ? "${mpiHome}/bin/mpiexec" : '')
    def candidateMpiExec = mpiExec ?: "${env.WORKSPACE}/gkylsoft/openmpi/bin/mpiexec"
    def baselineMpiExec = mpiExec ?: "${env.WORKSPACE}/_baseline/gkylsoft/openmpi/bin/mpiexec"
    def gkeyll = "${env.WORKSPACE}/gkylsoft/gkeyll/bin/gkeyll"
    def baselineGkeyll = "${env.WORKSPACE}/_baseline/gkylsoft/gkeyll/bin/gkeyll"
    def results = "${env.WORKSPACE}/gkylsoft/gkeyll-results/parallel-c-4"
    def baselineResults = "${env.WORKSPACE}/_baseline/gkylsoft/gkeyll-results/parallel-c-4"
    loggedSh("shared-parallel-regressions", """#!/bin/bash
        set -euo pipefail
        test -x "${candidateMpiExec}"
        test -x "${baselineMpiExec}"

        "${baselineGkeyll}" runregression configure --source-dir "${env.WORKSPACE}/_baseline" --prefix "${env.WORKSPACE}/_baseline/gkylsoft" --results-subdir parallel-c-4 --mpiexec "${baselineMpiExec}"
        started=\$(date +%s)
        "${baselineGkeyll}" runregression run --c-only --parallel --jobs ${env.PERSONAL_BUILD_JOBS ?: '3'} compile
        elapsed=\$(( \$(date +%s) - started ))
        printf '%s\\n' "\$elapsed" > baseline-parallel-c-compile-seconds.txt

        started=\$(date +%s)
        "${baselineGkeyll}" runregression run --c-only --parallel --execute-only create
        elapsed=\$(( \$(date +%s) - started ))
        printf '%s\\n' "\$elapsed" > baseline-parallel-c-regression-create-seconds.txt

        "${gkeyll}" runregression configure --source-dir "${env.WORKSPACE}" --prefix "${env.WORKSPACE}/gkylsoft" --results-subdir parallel-c-4 --mpiexec "${candidateMpiExec}"
        started=\$(date +%s)
        "${gkeyll}" runregression run --c-only --parallel --jobs ${env.PERSONAL_BUILD_JOBS ?: '3'} compile
        elapsed=\$(( \$(date +%s) - started ))
        printf '%s\\n' "\$elapsed" > candidate-parallel-c-compile-seconds.txt

        for layer in moments vlasov gyrokinetic pkpm; do
            if [ -d "${baselineResults}/\$layer/creg-accepted" ]; then
                rm -rf "${results}/\$layer/creg-accepted"
                mv "${baselineResults}/\$layer/creg-accepted" "${results}/\$layer/creg-accepted"
            fi
        done
        started=\$(date +%s)
        "${gkeyll}" runregression run --c-only --parallel --execute-only check
        elapsed=\$(( \$(date +%s) - started ))
        printf '%s\\n' "\$elapsed" > candidate-parallel-c-regression-check-seconds.txt
        "${gkeyll}" ci/jenkins/check_regression_results.lua "${results}" ci/jenkins/expected_regression_diffs.txt ci-parallel-regression-summary.txt
    """)
}

def writeCiTimingSummary() {
    sh '''#!/bin/bash
        set -euo pipefail

        metric() {
            local file="$1"
            if [[ -f "$file" ]]; then
                local value
                value="$(tr -d '[:space:]' < "$file")"
                if [[ -n "$value" ]]; then
                    printf '%s' "$value"
                    return
                fi
            fi
            printf 'not-recorded'
        }

        candidate_unit_build="$(metric candidate-unit-build-seconds.txt)"
        baseline_unit_build="$(metric baseline-unit-build-seconds.txt)"
        candidate_unit_test="$(metric candidate-unit-test-seconds.txt)"
        baseline_unit_test="$(metric baseline-unit-test-seconds.txt)"
        candidate_regression_build="$(metric candidate-regression-build-seconds.txt)"
        baseline_regression_build="$(metric baseline-regression-build-seconds.txt)"
        candidate_install="$(metric candidate-install-seconds.txt)"
        baseline_install="$(metric baseline-install-seconds.txt)"
        candidate_compile="$(metric candidate-c-compile-seconds.txt)"
        baseline_compile="$(metric baseline-c-compile-seconds.txt)"
        candidate_parallel_compile="$(metric candidate-parallel-c-compile-seconds.txt)"
        baseline_parallel_compile="$(metric baseline-parallel-c-compile-seconds.txt)"
        regression_create="$(metric baseline-c-regression-create-seconds.txt)"
        regression_check="$(metric candidate-c-regression-check-seconds.txt)"
        parallel_regression_create="$(metric baseline-parallel-c-regression-create-seconds.txt)"
        parallel_regression_check="$(metric candidate-parallel-c-regression-check-seconds.txt)"

        {
            printf 'candidate_unit_build_seconds=%s\n' "$candidate_unit_build"
            printf 'baseline_unit_build_seconds=%s\n' "$baseline_unit_build"
            printf 'candidate_unit_test_seconds=%s\n' "$candidate_unit_test"
            printf 'baseline_unit_test_seconds=%s\n' "$baseline_unit_test"
            printf 'candidate_regression_build_seconds=%s\n' "$candidate_regression_build"
            printf 'baseline_regression_build_seconds=%s\n' "$baseline_regression_build"
            printf 'candidate_install_seconds=%s\n' "$candidate_install"
            printf 'baseline_install_seconds=%s\n' "$baseline_install"
            printf 'candidate_c_compile_seconds=%s\n' "$candidate_compile"
            printf 'baseline_c_compile_seconds=%s\n' "$baseline_compile"
            printf 'candidate_parallel_c_compile_seconds=%s\n' "$candidate_parallel_compile"
            printf 'baseline_parallel_c_compile_seconds=%s\n' "$baseline_parallel_compile"
            printf 'baseline_c_regression_create_seconds=%s\n' "$regression_create"
            printf 'candidate_c_regression_check_seconds=%s\n' "$regression_check"
            printf 'baseline_parallel_c_regression_create_seconds=%s\n' "$parallel_regression_create"
            printf 'candidate_parallel_c_regression_check_seconds=%s\n' "$parallel_regression_check"
        } > ci-timing-summary.txt
        cat ci-timing-summary.txt
    '''
}

def candidatePr = params.CANDIDATE_PR?.trim() ?: env.CI_CANDIDATE_PR?.trim()
def candidateRef = params.CANDIDATE_REF?.trim() ?: env.CI_CANDIDATE_REF?.trim()
def queuedCommit = params.CI_QUEUE_COMMIT?.trim()
if (queuedCommit && !isCommitSha(queuedCommit)) error('CI_QUEUE_COMMIT must be a full commit SHA.')
def requestedBaseline = params.BASELINE_REF?.trim() ?: env.CI_BASELINE_REF?.trim()
if (!!candidatePr == !!candidateRef) error('Set exactly one of CANDIDATE_PR or CANDIDATE_REF.')
if (candidatePr && !(candidatePr ==~ /[1-9][0-9]*/)) error("CANDIDATE_PR must be a positive integer, got '${candidatePr}'.")
if (candidatePr && requestedBaseline) error('BASELINE_REF must be empty with CANDIDATE_PR.')
if (candidateRef) { candidateRef = validateRef('CANDIDATE_REF', candidateRef); requestedBaseline = validateRef('BASELINE_REF', requestedBaseline) }

def label = requireValue('PERSONAL_NODE_LABEL', env.PERSONAL_NODE_LABEL)
def mkdeps = validateBranchName('PERSONAL_MKDEPS_SCRIPT', requireValue('PERSONAL_MKDEPS_SCRIPT', env.PERSONAL_MKDEPS_SCRIPT))
def configure = validateBranchName('PERSONAL_CONFIGURE_SCRIPT', requireValue('PERSONAL_CONFIGURE_SCRIPT', env.PERSONAL_CONFIGURE_SCRIPT))
def statusCredentialsId = requireValue('PERSONAL_GITHUB_CREDENTIAL_ID', env.PERSONAL_GITHUB_CREDENTIAL_ID)
def jobs = (env.PERSONAL_BUILD_JOBS ?: '3').trim()
def regressionJobs = (env.PERSONAL_REGRESSION_JOBS ?: env.PERSONAL_BUILD_JOBS ?: '3').trim()
def mpiExec = (env.PERSONAL_MPIEXEC ?: '').trim()
if (!(jobs ==~ /[1-9][0-9]*/) || !(regressionJobs ==~ /[1-9][0-9]*/)) error('PERSONAL_BUILD_JOBS and PERSONAL_REGRESSION_JOBS must be positive integers.')

def ciStage(String stageName, Closure body) {
    env.CI_FAILURE_STAGE = stageName
    stage(stageName) { body.call() }
}

def writeCiFailureSummary(String result, String stageName, String message) {
    def compactMessage = (message ?: 'unknown failure').replaceAll('[\\r\\n]+', ' ').trim().take(500)
    writeFile file: 'ci-failure-summary.txt', text: "result=${result}\nstage=${stageName ?: 'unknown'}\nmessage=${compactMessage}\n"
}

def runCi = {
    def commit = queuedCommit ?: (isCommitSha(candidateRef ?: '') ? candidateRef : '')
    def status = 'failure'
    def description = 'Personal CI failed.'
    def failureMessage = ''
    def platform = env.CI_PLATFORM?.trim() ?: 'personal'
    // Every controller needs its own status context, otherwise two machines
    // testing the same commit overwrite each other's status on GitHub.
    def statusContext = params.CI_QUEUE_CONTEXT?.trim() ?: env.CI_STATUS_CONTEXT?.trim() ?: env.PERSONAL_STATUS_CONTEXT?.trim()
    if (!statusContext) {
        def host = sh(returnStdout: true, script: 'hostname -s 2>/dev/null || hostname').trim().toLowerCase().replaceAll(/[^a-z0-9._-]/, '-')
        statusContext = "continuous-integration/jenkins/personal-${host ?: 'unknown'}"
    }
    try {
        ciStage('Resolve candidate and baseline') {
            currentBuild.displayName = "#${env.BUILD_NUMBER} ${candidatePr ? "PR-${candidatePr}" : shortRef(candidateRef)}"
            if (candidatePr) { candidateRef = "PR #${candidatePr}"; requestedBaseline = pullRequestBase(statusCredentialsId, candidatePr) }
            currentBuild.description = "${shortRef(candidateRef)} vs ${shortRef(requestedBaseline)}"
        }
        ciStage('Checkout candidate') {
            deleteDir()
            // Report and test the exact commit accepted by the controller's queue listener.
            if (queuedCommit) checkoutRef(queuedCommit, 'candidate')
            else if (candidatePr) checkoutPullRequest(candidatePr)
            else checkoutRef(candidateRef, 'candidate')
            commit = sh(returnStdout: true, script: 'git rev-parse HEAD').trim()
            writeFile file: 'ci-candidate-commit.txt', text: "${commit}\n"
            // Written after deleteDir() above so it survives into the artifacts and report.
            writeFile file: 'ci-selection.txt', text: "candidate_selector=${candidateRef}\nbaseline_selector=${requestedBaseline}\n"
            currentBuild.description += " @ ${commit.take(7)}"
            if (env.CI_TRUSTED_CI_COMMIT?.trim()) {
                writeFile file: 'ci-trusted-ci-commit.txt', text: "${env.CI_TRUSTED_CI_COMMIT.trim()}\n"
            }
        }
        ciStage('Report pending') { publishStatus(statusCredentialsId, statusContext, commit, 'pending', 'Gkeyll CI is running.') }
        ciStage('Build candidate') { buildTree('candidate', "${env.WORKSPACE}/gkylsoft", mkdeps, configure, jobs) }
        ciStage('Build baseline') { createBaseline(requestedBaseline, mkdeps, configure, jobs, regressionJobs) }
        ciStage('C regressions') { runCandidateRegressions(jobs, regressionJobs) }
        ciStage('Parallel C regressions') { runParallelRegressions(mpiExec); status = 'success'; description = 'Personal CI passed.' }
    } catch (err) {
        failureMessage = err.toString()
        if (currentBuild.currentResult == 'ABORTED' || err.toString().contains('FlowInterruptedException')) { status = 'error'; description = 'Personal CI was aborted.' }
        throw err
    } finally {
        try {
            writeCiTimingSummary()
        } catch (err) {
            status = 'error'
            description = 'Personal CI timing summary failed.'
            if (!failureMessage) {
                failureMessage = err.toString()
                env.CI_FAILURE_STAGE = 'Write CI timing summary'
            } else {
                failureMessage += " | Timing summary also failed: ${err}"
            }
            currentBuild.result = 'FAILURE'
            echo "WARNING: could not write CI timings: ${err}"
        } finally {
            if (status != 'success') writeCiFailureSummary(status, env.CI_FAILURE_STAGE, failureMessage ?: description)
            // Best effort: a GitHub outage must not turn a passing build red.
            // The commit status below remains the authoritative signal.
            def reportError = ''
            if (commit || candidatePr || candidateRef) {
                try {
                    def summaryLine = publishReport(statusCredentialsId, statusContext, platform, commit, status, candidatePr ?: '', candidateRef ?: '')
                    if (summaryLine) description = summaryLine.take(140)
                } catch (err) {
                    reportError = err.toString()
                    echo "WARNING: could not publish the GitHub CI report: ${reportError}"
                }
            }
            archiveArtifacts allowEmptyArchive: true, artifacts: 'ci-selection.txt,ci-trusted-ci-commit.txt,ci-candidate-commit.txt,ci-baseline-commit.txt,*-seconds.txt,*-unit-results.txt,candidate-*.log,baseline-*.log,ci-failure-detail.txt,ci-report*.md,ci-report*.md.json,ci-command-logs/**,ci-timing-summary.txt,ci-regression-summary.txt,ci-parallel-regression-summary.txt,ci-failure-summary.txt,build/**/*.log,gkylsoft/gkeyll-results/**/regressiondb,gkylsoft/gkeyll-results/**/_rr_failures.txt'
            if (reportError) description = "${description} (report not posted)".take(140)
        }
        if (commit) publishStatus(statusCredentialsId, statusContext, commit, status, description)
        deleteDir()
    }
}

// The team-workstation inline bootstrap already owns the agent while it
// checks out this trusted workflow from main. Reusing that allocation avoids
// a nested node() request, which can deadlock a one-executor workstation.
if (env.CI_NODE_ALREADY_ALLOCATED == 'true') {
    runCi()
} else {
    node(label) {
        runCi()
    }
}
// Manual, CPU-only Level-1 CI for Princeton's Stellar CPU cluster.
//
// Configure the Jenkins job to load *this file* from a reviewed, trusted CI
// branch while Level 1 is being brought up. The PR checkout below is
// intentionally separate: a pull request must not be able to replace the
// pipeline that decides what SLURM work to submit. Once validated, the job can
// move to main without changing this file.

properties([
    buildDiscarder(logRotator(
        numToKeepStr: '20',
        artifactNumToKeepStr: '20'
    )),
    disableConcurrentBuilds(),
    parameters([
        string(
            name: 'CANDIDATE_PR',
            defaultValue: '',
            trim: true,
            description: 'GitHub pull-request number. Set exactly one of CANDIDATE_PR or CANDIDATE_REF.'
        ),
        string(
            name: 'CANDIDATE_REF',
            defaultValue: '',
            trim: true,
            description: 'Candidate branch name or full 40-character commit SHA. Requires BASELINE_REF.'
        ),
        string(
            name: 'BASELINE_REF',
            defaultValue: '',
            trim: true,
            description: 'Baseline branch name or full 40-character commit SHA for CANDIDATE_REF runs.'
        )
    ])
])

def requireValue(String name, String value) {
    value = value?.trim()
    if (!value) {
        error("${name} is not configured. See ci/jenkins/README.stellar_cpu.md.")
    }
    return value
}

def buildJobs() {
    def value = (env.STELLAR_CPU_BUILD_JOBS ?: '3').trim()
    return positiveInteger('STELLAR_CPU_BUILD_JOBS', value)
}

def positiveInteger(String name, String value) {
    if (!(value ==~ /[1-9][0-9]*/)) {
        error("${name} must be a positive integer, got '${value}'.")
    }
    return value
}

def regressionJobs() {
    return positiveInteger(
        'STELLAR_CPU_REGRESSION_JOBS',
        (env.STELLAR_CPU_REGRESSION_JOBS ?: '4').trim()
    )
}

def regressionTestTimeout() {
    return positiveInteger(
        'STELLAR_CPU_REGRESSION_TEST_TIMEOUT',
        (env.STELLAR_CPU_REGRESSION_TEST_TIMEOUT ?: '900').trim()
    )
}

def isCommitSha(String value) {
    return value ==~ /[0-9a-fA-F]{40}/
}

def shortRef(String ref) {
    return isCommitSha(ref) ? ref.take(7) : ref
}

def validateBranchName(String name, String value) {
    if (!(value ==~ /[A-Za-z0-9][A-Za-z0-9._\/-]*/)
        || value.contains('..') || value.contains('//')
        || value.endsWith('/') || value.endsWith('.') || value.endsWith('.lock')) {
        error("${name} must be a safe branch name or a full 40-character commit SHA, got '${value}'.")
    }
    return value
}

def validateRefSelector(String name, String value) {
    value = requireValue(name, value)
    return isCommitSha(value) ? value.toLowerCase() : validateBranchName(name, value)
}

def checkoutPullRequest(String prNumber) {
    checkout([
        $class: 'GitSCM',
        branches: [[name: "refs/remotes/origin/candidate"]],
        doGenerateSubmoduleConfigurations: false,
        extensions: [
            [$class: 'CleanBeforeCheckout'],
            [$class: 'CloneOption', depth: 1, honorRefspec: true, noTags: true, shallow: true]
        ],
        userRemoteConfigs: [[
            refspec: "+refs/pull/${prNumber}/head:refs/remotes/origin/candidate",
            url: 'https://github.com/gkeyllorg/gkeyll.git'
        ]]
    ])
}

def checkoutRef(String selector, String localRef) {
    def refspec = isCommitSha(selector)
        ? "+${selector}:refs/remotes/origin/${localRef}"
        : "+refs/heads/${selector}:refs/remotes/origin/${localRef}"
    checkout([
        $class: 'GitSCM',
        branches: [[name: "refs/remotes/origin/${localRef}"]],
        doGenerateSubmoduleConfigurations: false,
        extensions: [
            [$class: 'CleanBeforeCheckout'],
            [$class: 'CloneOption', depth: 1, honorRefspec: true, noTags: true, shallow: true]
        ],
        userRemoteConfigs: [[
            refspec: refspec,
            url: 'https://github.com/gkeyllorg/gkeyll.git'
        ]]
    ])
}

def resolvePullRequestBase(String statusCredentialsId, String prNumber) {
    def baseRef = ''
    withCredentials([usernamePassword(
        credentialsId: statusCredentialsId,
        usernameVariable: 'GITHUB_STATUS_USERNAME',
        passwordVariable: 'GITHUB_STATUS_TOKEN'
    )]) {
        withEnv(["GITHUB_PR_NUMBER=${prNumber}"]) {
            baseRef = sh(returnStdout: true, script: '''#!/bin/bash
                set -euo pipefail
                curl --fail --silent --show-error \
                    --retry 2 --connect-timeout 15 --max-time 45 \
                    --header 'Accept: application/vnd.github+json' \
                    --header 'X-GitHub-Api-Version: 2022-11-28' \
                    --header "Authorization: Bearer ${GITHUB_STATUS_TOKEN}" \
                    "https://api.github.com/repos/gkeyllorg/gkeyll/pulls/${GITHUB_PR_NUMBER}" \
                    | python3 -c '
import json
import sys

pull = json.load(sys.stdin)
base_ref = (pull.get("base") or {}).get("ref") or ""
if not isinstance(base_ref, str):
    raise SystemExit("GitHub pull-request base ref is not a string")
print(base_ref)
'
            ''').trim()
        }
    }
    return validateBranchName('GitHub PR base branch', baseRef)
}

def publishGitHubCommitStatus(String statusCredentialsId, String commit, String state, String description) {
    if (!(commit ==~ /[0-9a-f]{40}/)) {
        error("Cannot publish a GitHub status for invalid commit SHA '${commit}'.")
    }
    if (state == 'pending' && params.CI_QUEUE_ID?.trim()) {
        description = "Gkeyll CI running: starting (Jenkins queue #${params.CI_QUEUE_ID})."
    }
    if (!['pending', 'success', 'failure', 'error'].contains(state)) {
        error("Invalid GitHub commit-status state '${state}'.")
    }

    // Bind the token only for this trusted API request, never while a shell
    // command from the PR checkout is running.
    withCredentials([usernamePassword(
        credentialsId: statusCredentialsId,
        usernameVariable: 'GITHUB_STATUS_USERNAME',
        passwordVariable: 'GITHUB_STATUS_TOKEN'
    )]) {
        withEnv([
            "GITHUB_STATUS_COMMIT=${commit}",
            "GITHUB_STATUS_STATE=${state}",
            "GITHUB_STATUS_DESCRIPTION=${description}"
        ]) {
            sh '''#!/bin/bash
                set -euo pipefail

                payload="$(printf '{"state":"%s","context":"continuous-integration/jenkins/stellar_cpu","description":"%s"}' "${GITHUB_STATUS_STATE}" "${GITHUB_STATUS_DESCRIPTION}")"
                curl --fail --silent --show-error \
                    --retry 2 --connect-timeout 15 --max-time 45 \
                    --request POST \
                    --header 'Accept: application/vnd.github+json' \
                    --header 'X-GitHub-Api-Version: 2022-11-28' \
                    --header "Authorization: Bearer ${GITHUB_STATUS_TOKEN}" \
                    --header 'Content-Type: application/json' \
                    --data "$payload" \
                    --output /dev/null --write-out 'GitHub Stellar status: %{http_code}\\n' \
                    "https://api.github.com/repos/gkeyllorg/gkeyll/statuses/${GITHUB_STATUS_COMMIT}"
            '''
        }
    }
}

// Capture stdout and stderr without losing the command's exit status. Never
// use this for credential-bearing commands. Logs live outside the baseline tree.
def loggedSh(String label, String script) {
    def quoted = "'" + script.replace("'", "'\"'\"'") + "'"
    withEnv(["CI_COMMAND_LOG=${env.WORKSPACE}/ci-command-logs/${label}.log"]) {
        sh """#!/bin/bash
            set -uo pipefail
            mkdir -p "\$WORKSPACE/ci-command-logs"
            bash ${script.startsWith('#!/bin/bash -l') ? '-l' : ''} -e -o pipefail -c ${quoted} 2>&1 | tee "\$CI_COMMAND_LOG"
            result=\$?
            printf '%s\\n' "\$result" > "\$CI_COMMAND_LOG.exit"
            exit "\$result"
        """
    }
}

def trustedReportScript() {
    // The report tool must come from reviewed code, never from the candidate
    // checkout, because 'publish' runs with the GitHub token bound.
    // GKEYLL_CI_TRUSTED_REF exists so a reviewed CI branch can be staged
    // before merge; production controllers leave it unset (main).
    def ref = validateRefSelector('GKEYLL_CI_TRUSTED_REF', env.GKEYLL_CI_TRUSTED_REF?.trim() ?: 'main')
    withEnv(["CI_TRUSTED_REPORT_REF=${ref}"]) {
        sh '''#!/bin/bash -l
            set -euo pipefail
            mkdir -p .ci-report-source
            git -C .ci-report-source init --quiet
            git -C .ci-report-source fetch --quiet --depth 1 https://github.com/gkeyllorg/gkeyll.git "$CI_TRUSTED_REPORT_REF"
            git -C .ci-report-source show FETCH_HEAD:ci/jenkins/github_report.py > _trusted_github_report.py
        '''
    }
    return '_trusted_github_report.py'
}

def publishGitHubReport(String statusCredentialsId, String commit, String state, String candidatePr, String candidateRef) {
    // Builds ci-report.md from the workspace summaries and posts it as one
    // pull-request comment (or commit comment) that later runs update in place.
    def script = trustedReportScript()
    withEnv(["CI_REPORT_CONTEXT=continuous-integration/jenkins/stellar_cpu", "CI_REPORT_PLATFORM=stellar_cpu", "CI_REPORT_RESULT=${state}",
             "CI_REPORT_PR=${candidatePr ?: ''}", "CI_REPORT_COMMIT=${commit}", "CI_REPORT_REF=${candidateRef ?: ''}"]) {
        sh "python3 ${script} build --platform \"\$CI_REPORT_PLATFORM\" --context \"\$CI_REPORT_CONTEXT\" --result \"\$CI_REPORT_RESULT\" --pr \"\$CI_REPORT_PR\" --output ci-report.md"
        withCredentials([usernamePassword(
            credentialsId: statusCredentialsId,
            usernameVariable: 'GITHUB_USERNAME',
            passwordVariable: 'GITHUB_TOKEN'
        )]) {
            retry(3) {
                sh "python3 ${script} publish --report ci-report.md --commit \"\$CI_REPORT_COMMIT\" --context \"\$CI_REPORT_CONTEXT\" --pr \"\$CI_REPORT_PR\" --ref \"\$CI_REPORT_REF\""
            }
        }
    }
}

def submitSlurmJob(String kind, String payload, String cpus, String timeLimit, List<String> extraExports = [], String tasks = '1') {
    def qos = requireValue('STELLAR_CPU_SLURM_QOS', env.STELLAR_CPU_SLURM_QOS)
    def account = env.STELLAR_CPU_SLURM_ACCOUNT?.trim()
    def idFile = "slurm-${kind}-job-id.txt"
    def statusFile = "slurm-${kind}-job-status.txt"
    def outputFile = "slurm-${kind}-%j.out"
    def exports = [
        "CI_WORKSPACE=${env.WORKSPACE}",
        "CI_SLURM_JOB_KIND=${kind}",
        "CI_SLURM_JOB_ID_FILE=${idFile}",
        "CI_SLURM_JOB_STATUS_FILE=${statusFile}"
    ] + extraExports

    withEnv([
        "CI_WORKSPACE=${env.WORKSPACE}",
        "CI_SLURM_JOB_KIND=${kind}",
        "CI_SLURM_JOB_ID_FILE=${idFile}",
        "CI_SLURM_JOB_STATUS_FILE=${statusFile}",
        "CI_STELLAR_CPU_QOS=${qos}",
        "CI_STELLAR_CPU_TIME=${timeLimit}",
        "CI_STELLAR_CPU_ACCOUNT=${account ?: ''}",
        "CI_STELLAR_CPU_CPUS=${cpus}",
        "CI_SLURM_TASKS=${tasks}",
        "CI_SLURM_PAYLOAD=${payload}",
        "CI_SLURM_EXPORTS=${exports.join(',')}",
        "CI_SLURM_OUTPUT=${outputFile}"
    ]) {
        loggedSh("shared-slurm-${kind}", '''#!/bin/bash -l
            set -euo pipefail

            job_id=''

            write_status() {
                printf 'job_id=%s\nstate=%s\nexit_code=%s\nelapsed_seconds=%s\n' \
                    "$job_id" "$1" "${2:-}" "${3:-}" > "$CI_SLURM_JOB_STATUS_FILE"
            }

            cancel_submitted_job() {
                trap - INT TERM
                if [[ -z "$job_id" ]]; then
                    exit 143
                fi

                echo "Jenkins interrupted; cancelling Slurm job $job_id"
                scancel "$job_id" || true
                while :; do
                    state="$(squeue --noheader --jobs="$job_id" --format='%T' | head -n 1 || true)"
                    if [[ -z "$state" ]]; then
                        break
                    fi
                    echo "Waiting for Slurm job $job_id to stop (state: $state)"
                    sleep 5
                done
                write_status 'CANCELLED_BY_JENKINS'
                exit 143
            }

            trap cancel_submitted_job INT TERM

            sbatch_args=(
                --parsable
                "--job-name=gkyl-ci-${CI_SLURM_JOB_KIND}-${BUILD_NUMBER}"
                --nodes=1
                "--ntasks=${CI_SLURM_TASKS}"
                "--cpus-per-task=${CI_STELLAR_CPU_CPUS}"
                "--qos=${CI_STELLAR_CPU_QOS}"
                "--time=${CI_STELLAR_CPU_TIME}"
                "--output=${CI_WORKSPACE}/${CI_SLURM_OUTPUT}"
                "--chdir=${CI_WORKSPACE}"
                "--export=ALL,${CI_SLURM_EXPORTS}"
            )
            if [[ -n "${CI_STELLAR_CPU_ACCOUNT:-}" ]]; then
                sbatch_args+=("--account=${CI_STELLAR_CPU_ACCOUNT}")
            fi

            submission="$(sbatch "${sbatch_args[@]}" "$CI_SLURM_PAYLOAD")"
            job_id="${submission%%;*}"
            if [[ ! "$job_id" =~ ^[0-9]+(_[0-9]+)?$ ]]; then
                echo "ERROR: Could not parse Slurm job ID from: $submission" >&2
                exit 1
            fi
            printf '%s\n' "$job_id" > "$CI_SLURM_JOB_ID_FILE"
            echo "Submitted ${CI_SLURM_JOB_KIND} Slurm job $job_id"

            previous_state=''
            while :; do
                state="$(squeue --noheader --jobs="$job_id" --format='%T' | head -n 1 || true)"
                if [[ -z "$state" ]]; then
                    break
                fi
                if [[ "$state" != "$previous_state" ]]; then
                    echo "${CI_SLURM_JOB_KIND} Slurm job $job_id state: $state"
                    previous_state="$state"
                fi
                sleep 5
            done

            # Slurm accounting can lag briefly after a job disappears from
            # squeue. Query the allocation record only (-X) until it appears.
            record=''
            for attempt in {1..6}; do
                record="$(sacct --noheader --parsable2 --allocations --jobs="$job_id" \
                    --format=State,ExitCode,ElapsedRaw | head -n 1 || true)"
                if [[ -n "$record" ]]; then
                    break
                fi
                echo "Waiting for Slurm accounting record for job $job_id ($attempt/6)"
                sleep 5
            done
            if [[ -z "$record" ]]; then
                write_status 'UNKNOWN'
                echo "ERROR: No Slurm accounting record found for job $job_id" >&2
                exit 1
            fi

            IFS='|' read -r final_state exit_code elapsed_seconds <<< "$record"
            write_status "$final_state" "$exit_code" "$elapsed_seconds"
            echo "${CI_SLURM_JOB_KIND} Slurm job $job_id finished: state=$final_state exit_code=$exit_code elapsed_seconds=$elapsed_seconds"
            if [[ "$final_state" == COMPLETED* && "$exit_code" == '0:0' ]]; then
                exit 0
            fi
            exit 1
        ''')
    }
}

def finalizeUnfinishedSlurmJob() {
    // Jenkins may terminate a durable-task process tree before its shell trap
    // completes. Run this from the Pipeline finally block as a second chance
    // to cancel a submitted job and preserve an abort-status artifact.
    sh '''#!/bin/bash -l
        set -euo pipefail

        for id_file in slurm-*-job-id.txt; do
            [[ -e "$id_file" ]] || continue
            status_file="${id_file%-id.txt}-status.txt"
            [[ -e "$status_file" ]] && continue

            job_id="$(<"$id_file")"
            if [[ ! "$job_id" =~ ^[0-9]+(_[0-9]+)?$ ]]; then
                printf 'job_id=%s\nstate=UNKNOWN\nexit_code=\n' "$job_id" > "$status_file"
                echo "WARNING: Cannot cancel malformed Slurm job ID '$job_id'" >&2
                continue
            fi

            echo "Pipeline finalizer: cancelling unfinished Slurm job $job_id"
            scancel "$job_id" || true
            while :; do
                state="$(squeue --noheader --jobs="$job_id" --format='%T' | head -n 1 || true)"
                if [[ -z "$state" ]]; then
                    break
                fi
                echo "Pipeline finalizer: waiting for job $job_id to stop (state: $state)"
                sleep 5
            done
            printf 'job_id=%s\nstate=CANCELLED_BY_JENKINS\nexit_code=\n' "$job_id" > "$status_file"
        done
    '''
}

def writeCiTimingSummary() {
    sh '''#!/bin/bash -l
        set -euo pipefail

        metric() {
            local file="$1"
            local key="$2"
            if [[ -f "$file" ]]; then
                local value
                if [[ "$key" == '__file__' ]]; then
                    value="$(tr -d '[:space:]' < "$file")"
                else
                    value="$(sed -n -E "s/^${key}=//p" "$file" | tail -n 1)"
                fi
                if [[ -n "$value" ]]; then
                    printf '%s' "$value"
                    return
                fi
            fi
            printf 'not-recorded'
        }

        candidate_compile="$(metric candidate-c-compile-seconds.txt __file__)"
        baseline_compile="$(metric baseline-c-compile-seconds.txt __file__)"
        candidate_parallel_compile="$(metric candidate-parallel-c-compile-seconds.txt __file__)"
        baseline_parallel_compile="$(metric baseline-parallel-c-compile-seconds.txt __file__)"
        candidate_install="$(metric candidate-install-seconds.txt __file__)"
        baseline_install="$(metric baseline-install-seconds.txt __file__)"
        candidate_unit_build="$(metric candidate-unit-build-seconds.txt __file__)"
        baseline_unit_build="$(metric baseline-unit-build-seconds.txt __file__)"
        candidate_unit_test="$(metric unit-test-seconds.txt __file__)"
        baseline_unit_test='not-recorded'
        regression_create="$(metric baseline-c-regression-create-seconds.txt __file__)"
        regression_check="$(metric candidate-c-regression-check-seconds.txt __file__)"
        parallel_regression_create="$(metric baseline-parallel-c-regression-create-seconds.txt __file__)"
        parallel_regression_check="$(metric candidate-parallel-c-regression-check-seconds.txt __file__)"
        unit_elapsed="$(metric slurm-unit-job-status.txt elapsed_seconds)"
        regression_elapsed="$(metric slurm-regression-job-status.txt elapsed_seconds)"
        parallel_regression_elapsed="$(metric slurm-parallel-regression-job-status.txt elapsed_seconds)"
        c_passed="$(metric ci-regression-summary.txt c_regression_passed)"
        c_acknowledged="$(metric ci-regression-summary.txt c_regression_acknowledged)"
        c_unacknowledged="$(metric ci-regression-summary.txt c_regression_unacknowledged)"

        compile_total='not-recorded'
        if [[ "$candidate_compile" =~ ^[0-9]+$ && "$baseline_compile" =~ ^[0-9]+$ ]]; then
            compile_total="$((candidate_compile + baseline_compile))"
        fi

        {
            printf 'candidate_c_compile_seconds=%s\n' "$candidate_compile"
            printf 'baseline_c_compile_seconds=%s\n' "$baseline_compile"
            printf 'candidate_parallel_c_compile_seconds=%s\n' "$candidate_parallel_compile"
            printf 'baseline_parallel_c_compile_seconds=%s\n' "$baseline_parallel_compile"
            printf 'login_c_compile_seconds=%s\n' "$compile_total"
            printf 'candidate_install_seconds=%s\n' "$candidate_install"
            printf 'baseline_install_seconds=%s\n' "$baseline_install"
            printf 'candidate_unit_build_seconds=%s\n' "$candidate_unit_build"
            printf 'baseline_unit_build_seconds=%s\n' "$baseline_unit_build"
            printf 'candidate_unit_test_seconds=%s\n' "$candidate_unit_test"
            printf 'baseline_unit_test_seconds=%s\n' "$baseline_unit_test"
            printf 'baseline_c_regression_create_seconds=%s\n' "$regression_create"
            printf 'candidate_c_regression_check_seconds=%s\n' "$regression_check"
            printf 'baseline_parallel_c_regression_create_seconds=%s\n' "$parallel_regression_create"
            printf 'candidate_parallel_c_regression_check_seconds=%s\n' "$parallel_regression_check"
            printf 'unit_slurm_elapsed_seconds=%s\n' "$unit_elapsed"
            printf 'regression_slurm_elapsed_seconds=%s\n' "$regression_elapsed"
            printf 'parallel_regression_slurm_elapsed_seconds=%s\n' "$parallel_regression_elapsed"
            printf 'c_regression_passed=%s\n' "$c_passed"
            printf 'c_regression_acknowledged=%s\n' "$c_acknowledged"
            printf 'c_regression_unacknowledged=%s\n' "$c_unacknowledged"
        } > ci-timing-summary.txt
        cat ci-timing-summary.txt
    '''
}

def timingMetric(String key) {
    if (!fileExists('ci-timing-summary.txt')) {
        return 'n/a'
    }
    def expression = '(?m)^' + java.util.regex.Pattern.quote(key) + '=([^\\r\\n]+)$'
    def match = readFile('ci-timing-summary.txt') =~ expression
    return match.find() ? match.group(1) : 'n/a'
}

def timingStatusDescription(String status) {
    def passed = timingMetric('c_regression_passed')
    def acknowledged = timingMetric('c_regression_acknowledged')
    def unacknowledged = timingMetric('c_regression_unacknowledged')
    def candidateCompile = timingMetric('candidate_c_compile_seconds')
    def baselineCompile = timingMetric('baseline_c_compile_seconds')
    def unitElapsed = timingMetric('unit_slurm_elapsed_seconds')
    def regressionElapsed = timingMetric('regression_slurm_elapsed_seconds')
    def outcome = status == 'success' ? 'passed' : (status == 'error' ? 'errored' : 'failed')
    def description = "Stellar CI ${outcome}: C ${passed}/${acknowledged}/${unacknowledged}; comp C/B ${candidateCompile}/${baselineCompile}s; Slurm U/R ${unitElapsed}/${regressionElapsed}s"
    return description.take(140)
}

def candidatePr = params.CANDIDATE_PR?.trim()

}
if (candidatePr && requestedBaselineRef) {

def nodeLabel = (env.STELLAR_CPU_NODE_LABEL ?: 'stellar_cpu').trim()
def gkeyllCiRoot = requireValue('GKEYLL_CI_ROOT', env.GKEYLL_CI_ROOT)
def workspaceRoot = "${gkeyllCiRoot}/workspaces"
def statusCredentialsId = requireValue('STELLAR_CPU_GITHUB_CREDENTIAL_ID', env.STELLAR_CPU_GITHUB_CREDENTIAL_ID)
def candidateSelector = ''
def baselineSelector = ''
def queuedCommit = params.CI_QUEUE_COMMIT?.trim()
if (queuedCommit && !isCommitSha(queuedCommit)) error('CI_QUEUE_COMMIT must be a full commit SHA.')
def candidateCommit = queuedCommit ?: (isCommitSha(candidateRef ?: '') ? candidateRef : '')
def terminalStatus = 'failure'

def failureMessage = ''

def ciStage(String stageName, Closure body) {

def writeCiFailureSummary(String result, String stageName, String message) {
    def compactMessage = (message ?: 'unknown failure').replaceAll('[\\r\\n]+', ' ').trim().take(500)
    writeFile file: 'ci-failure-summary.txt', text: "result=${result}\nstage=${stageName ?: 'unknown'}\nmessage=${compactMessage}\n"

node(nodeLabel) {
    // Stellar compute nodes must see this path. Configure the root on a shared
    // filesystem such as the project's /scratch/gpfs location, never /tmp.
    ws("${workspaceRoot}/${env.JOB_NAME}/${env.BUILD_TAG}") {
        try {
            ciStage('Resolve candidate and baseline') {
                currentBuild.displayName = "#${env.BUILD_NUMBER} ${candidatePr ? "PR-${candidatePr}" : shortRef(candidateRef)}"
                if (candidatePr) {
                    candidateSelector = "PR #${candidatePr}"
                    baselineSelector = resolvePullRequestBase(statusCredentialsId, candidatePr)
                } else {
                    candidateSelector = candidateRef
                    baselineSelector = requestedBaselineRef
                }
                echo "Candidate selector: ${candidateSelector}"
                echo "Baseline selector: ${baselineSelector}"
                currentBuild.description = "${shortRef(candidateSelector)} vs ${shortRef(baselineSelector)}"
            }
            ciStage('Checkout candidate') {
                deleteDir()
                if (queuedCommit) {
                    checkoutRef(queuedCommit, 'candidate')
                } else if (candidatePr) {
                    checkoutPullRequest(candidatePr)
                } else {
                    checkoutRef(candidateRef, 'candidate')
                }
                candidateCommit = sh(returnStdout: true, script: 'git rev-parse HEAD').trim()
                writeFile file: 'ci-candidate-commit.txt', text: "${candidateCommit}\n"
                currentBuild.description += " @ ${candidateCommit.take(7)}"
                writeFile file: 'ci-selection.txt', text: "candidate_selector=${candidateSelector}\nbaseline_selector=${baselineSelector}\n"
                sh 'git status --short'
            }
            ciStage('Report pending to GitHub') {
                publishGitHubCommitStatus(
                    statusCredentialsId,
                    candidateCommit,
                    'pending',
                    'Stellar CPU candidate CI is running.'
                )
            }
            ciStage('Build dependencies') {
                withEnv(["PREFIX=${env.WORKSPACE}/gkylsoft"]) {
                    loggedSh("candidate-dependencies", '''#!/bin/bash -l
                        set -euo pipefail
                        ./machines/mkdeps.stellar-intel.sh
                    ''')
                }
            }
            ciStage('Configure') {
                withEnv(["PREFIX=${env.WORKSPACE}/gkylsoft"]) {
                    loggedSh("candidate-configure", '''#!/bin/bash -l
                        set -euo pipefail
                        ./machines/configure.stellar-intel.sh
                    ''')
                }
            }
            ciStage('Build unit tests') {
                def jobs = buildJobs()
                loggedSh("candidate-unit-build", """#!/bin/bash -l
                    set -euo pipefail
                    # Each Jenkins sh step is a new process, so source the
                    # same environment used by the Stellar machine scripts.
                    . machines/module_load.stellar-intel.sh
                    module list
                    started=\$(date +%s)
                    make -j${jobs} unit
                    elapsed=\$(( \$(date +%s) - started ))
                    printf '%s\\n' "\$elapsed" > candidate-unit-build-seconds.txt
                    echo "Candidate unit-test build time: \$elapsed seconds"
                """)
            }
            ciStage('Run unit tests (SLURM)') {
                submitUnitTests()
            }
            ciStage('Install candidate for C regression') {
                def jobs = buildJobs()
                loggedSh("candidate-install", """#!/bin/bash -l
                    set -euo pipefail
                    . machines/module_load.stellar-intel.sh

                            set -euo pipefail

            ciStage('Install Stellar CPU baseline') {

                dir('_baseline') {

                        set -euo pipefail

            }

            }

                    'candidate-parallel',
                    "${env.WORKSPACE}/gkylsoft/gkeyll/bin/gkeyll",
                    env.WORKSPACE,

                    'machines/module_load.stellar-intel.sh',
                    '--parallel', '--results-subdir parallel-c-4 --mpiexec srun'
                )
                configureAndCompileCRegressions(
                    'baseline-parallel',
                    "${env.WORKSPACE}/_baseline/gkylsoft/gkeyll/bin/gkeyll",
                    "${env.WORKSPACE}/_baseline",
                    "${env.WORKSPACE}/_baseline/gkylsoft",
                    'machines/module_load.stellar-intel.sh',

                submitParallelRegressionTests()

                terminalStatus = 'error'
                terminalDescription = 'Stellar CPU CPU CI was aborted.'

            } catch (err) {

                terminalDescription = 'Stellar CPU CPU CI cleanup failed.'
                if (!failureMessage) {
                    failureMessage = err.toString()

                } else {

                } catch (err) {

                        artifacts: 'ci-selection.txt,ci-candidate-commit.txt,ci-baseline-commit.txt,ci-report*.md,ci-report*.md.json,ci-command-logs/**,*-unit-results.txt,*-c-compile-seconds.txt,ci-timing-summary.txt,ci-regression-summary.txt,ci-failure-summary.txt,slurm-*.out,slurm-*-job-id.txt,slurm-*-job-status.txt,build/**/*.log,gkylsoft/gkeyll-results/**/regressiondb,gkylsoft/gkeyll-results/**/_rr_failures.txt,_baseline/gkylsoft/gkeyll-results/**/regressiondb,_baseline/gkylsoft/gkeyll-results/**/_rr_failures.txt'
                } catch (err) {

                    terminalDescription = 'Stellar CPU CPU CI artifact archival failed.'
                    throw err
                } finally {

// This runs on the controller, never in a candidate checkout or build executor.

import com.cloudbees.plugins.credentials.common.StandardUsernamePasswordCredentials
import com.cloudbees.plugins.credentials.domains.URIRequirementBuilder
import groovy.json.JsonOutput
import groovy.json.JsonSlurper
import hudson.ExtensionList
import hudson.model.Job
import hudson.model.ParametersAction
import hudson.model.ParametersDefinitionProperty
import hudson.model.Queue
import hudson.model.Result
import hudson.model.Run
import hudson.model.StringParameterValue
import hudson.model.TaskListener
import hudson.model.listeners.RunListener
